description: Stable error codes. `kind`: shape (from the change's type, before running), runtime (against the current character and ruleset; the character is unchanged), load (loadRuleset), action (startAction/continueAction), build (checkRelease), formula (parsing, checking and evaluating formulas; see docs/formulas.md).

items.description: The input does not match its JSON Schema.
The change type is not in the fixed set.
An ID is not in this ruleset.
A field ID is not in this ruleset.
Only input fields can be set or adjusted.
A value has the wrong type for its field, state key or parameter.

A value is outside the `min` and `max` of its field, state key or action parameter (for a quantity, below 0). Data: `target` (the field ID, state key, parameter name or `quantity`), and `min`, `max` or both: only the bounds the target declares.
The entry is not in this character's inventory, features or applied entries.

An instance ID is already used in this character; or, in startAction, two participants share a view `id`; or an entry has a standard copy's ID but another item, and is skipped. loadRuleset reports it too when two standard items derive the same instance ID. Data: `id`.
removeItem: the entry is a standard copy, which every character has. Data: `entry`.
The item's content type is not equippable.
The state key is not declared by the item's content type or templates (for an applied entry, by its source's). At load: a `reapply` key that isn't a state key of its content.
The template's appliesTo query does not match the item.
The choice path does not lead to a choice.

The option is not one of the choice's options, or a field parameter's field is outside its `where` set, or a tag set on a field or passed as a parameter is outside its `members` (data: `field` or `param`, `option`).
unchoose: the option is not picked.
setState or adjustState names a grant (`grant`) that isn't active on that copy or pick: no active holder grant there gives the content. Data: `grant`.
choose or unchoose on a choice a grant presets (its `choices`): the grant's picks are the choice's. Data: `path`.
The character pins pack versions that differ from the ruleset's.
The character file links, or the app passes a view for, a slot no loaded pack declares. The rest computes. Data: `link`, the slot ID.

The character's homebrew doesn't load on top of the ruleset, so the call computes nothing. One error per load error. Data: `cause` (the load error code: `unknown-reference`, `formula-error`, `homebrew-not-allowed`, `missing-dependency`, `safety-limit-exceeded`, …) and `detail` (that error's data); `path` points into the character (`/homebrew/content/0`). upgrade reports it in `report.errors` for homebrew that doesn't load on the new ruleset.

A linked character's value doesn't have its declared field's type, or two of its values share a field ID. The field's default is used. Data: `link`, `field`, `expected`. In startAction, a participant's value does: the action fails, data `role`, `id`, `field`, `expected`.
Strict mode: a rules issue rejected the batch (issues are attached).
finishCreation: the character still has rules issues or pending choices. `data.issues` lists them, each pending choice as `too-few-picks`.

An adjust's incoming-change effects roll dice, and the change's `faces` run out with no dice function to roll the rest. Data: `dice`, every dice `add` the adjust rolls, in order, as `{ source, dice }` (the effect's source and the dice as text), and `supplied`, the number of faces the change gave. Roll them and resend the batch with `faces`.
An adjust's `faces` has faces left over after its incoming-change effects rolled. Data: `supplied` and `used`, the number of faces given and used.
A pack needs a newer spec than this engine implements.
A pack's dependency is missing or its version is out of range.
The same pack was passed twice.
A character's homebrew overrides content (`override`) or changes settings, which homebrew may not do. Reported as the cause of `homebrew-error`. Data: `property`.
Two items in one pack share an ID.

Content refers to an ID that does not exist. Also raised when an action runs, for an addItem's item or an applyEffect's source that names no content or a template. A kept template (`keepsTemplates`) that names content other than a template is `unknown-reference` too, with kind `template`. A grant's preset `choices` naming a choice the granted content doesn't declare (or on a `scope: applied` grant) is kind `choice`; a literal preset option it doesn't offer, kind `option` or `content`.
Formulas depend on each other in a loop. At computeSheet time the looping fields carry this error instead of a value.

A formula in a pack does not parse or type-check (load-time wrapper; the cause is one of the formula codes). computeSheet also reports a computed value on a copy whose formula fails (data: `entry`, `name`, `cause`).
An effect targets a roll tally that no visible pack declares in `rollTallies`. Data: `tally`, `pack`.

An effect with `then` has no entry (a copy or an applied entry) its changes could name: it is in the rules' effects, a situational choice's or a choice's effects. Data: `effect` (the effect's ID, if any), `pack`.

A `keepsTemplates` entry keeps a template on content (`content`), which has no copy, and the template gives more than fields and tags: state, computed values, effects, actions, choices, grants or anything else a copy carries. Data: `item` (the keeping item), `template`, `keys` (what it gives), `pack`.
A link slot names a `pack` that is loaded too, and one of its declared fields isn't a field of that pack's ruleset (it and its dependencies) or has another type. Data: `link`, `field`, `pack`.
A follow-up with `create` isn't a derived offer: it has no `while`, or has `on` or `becomes`, `action` or `changes`, or `to`. Data: `followUp`, `pack`.

A pack's field families or shared view fields don't expand: a placeholder names no family, a view-field set is unknown, an expanded key isn't a field ID or comes out twice, or a family or set is declared twice. Data: `pack`, `message`.

A follow-up's `create` names a creation start from a pack that a character using the slot's `pack` wouldn't load: neither that pack nor one of its dependencies. Checked when the slot's pack is loaded too; `pnpm validate` checks it always. Data: `link`, `start`, `pack`.

A content item's `fields` don't match its content type: a required field is missing (after `extends`), a name the type doesn't declare, or a value of the wrong shape (a list for a number, boolean or dice field; not a string for a `string` or `id` field; not one of an enum's values; not a list for a `set` field). Data: `item`, `field`, `reason` (`missing`, `undeclared` or `wrong-type`), `pack`; `path` points to the field.
Two packs declare a template field (`templateFields`) with the same name and a different `type`, `of` or `values`. Data: `field`, `packs` (the earlier pack, then the later).

An action step names a role its action doesn't declare (`each: <role>`, or `to: <role>` other than `self` and `target`), hands off (`as: participant`) outside an `each` step, or has an `each` of its own inside an `each` branch step's cases. Data: `role` (when one is named), `step`, `pack`.
`extends` chains loop.
A safety limit (`safety-limits.json`) was reached. Data: `limit`, the limit's ID.
The action does not exist or is not available.

A situational choice is selected (true, or a non-default value) while its `available` condition is false. Data: `situational`, its qualified ID. Also a runtime error from applyChanges, for a choice an `adjust` carries in `situational` that isn't offered or whose `incoming` doesn't match the change; it rejects the batch.
A required action parameter is missing.
startAction: participants for a role the action doesn't declare, or a role's count outside its `min` and `max`. Data: `role`.
An outcome's `result` is not one of the action's declared `results`. Data: `result`. The formula type check also reports a literal `result` that isn't declared.

continueAction, or one of startAction's `answers`: the answer does not fit what the paused action needs (the wrong kind of answer, wrong number of faces, a face out of range, an unknown option, amounts that don't fit, or a handoff outcome whose `result` the used action doesn't declare). For `answers`, data: `index` (the answer's, from 0) and `needs` (the pause); an answer left over once the action finishes has `index` only.

A step that reads the proposed sheet can't build it: applying the changes the action has proposed `to: self` so far fails. Data: `step` (the step's path) and `error`, the batch's error with its `path`. A pack bug.
The formula text does not parse (data: offset, expected).
A name in a formula is neither a bound context root nor a visible field.
A formula calls a function that is not in the standard library or not bound here.
A formula calls a function with the wrong number of arguments.
An operator, function or place in a formula gets a type it doesn't accept.
A formula divides (/ or %) by zero.
An int result is outside ±(2^53 − 1), or a decimal result is not finite.
A path under a context root names something absent (use has()).
A list index is outside the list.
A supplied die face is not on the die (or not enough faces were supplied). In applyChanges, a face from an adjust's `faces` or the dice function that is off the die rejects the batch with this code.

A tag is not declared by the pack or its dependencies. Also reported when an action runs, for a computed tag (one a formula gives, or one of the list it gives), and by computeSheet as the error of a field whose computed tag isn't declared (data: `field`, `tag`).
A roll has both advantage and disadvantage under `settings.rollModifiers.advantage: stack`.
upgrade: the target version is below the character's pinned version.
upgrade: the character was written against a newer spec than this engine implements (its `specVersion`). Data: `specVersion`, the character's, and `implements`, the engine's `SPEC_VERSION`.
checkRelease: the new release's version is not greater than the previous one.
checkRelease: the release changes the saved state's shape or the pack's interface without a breaking version bump (the minor version before 1.0.0, the major version from 1.0.0).
checkRelease: the release changes the saved state's shape without an upgrade script from the previous version.
checkRelease: a shape change is not covered by any step of the upgrade script (data names it).
The character has no follow-up with this ID: a dismissFollowUp change's (no stored entry), or startAction's `action.followUp` (no offer computeSheet lists).
